item.title: Reconstructing the Jordan structure of $C^*$-algebras from the metric on positive unit spheres
item.description: arXiv:2610.32029v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Let $A$ and $B$ be unital $C^*$-algebras, and let $\mathrm{S}_{A^+}$ and $\mathrm{S}_{B^+}$ denote their positive unit spheres. We first show that the diametral relation on the positive unit sphere already determines Jordan structure. More precisely, suppose that $\Lambda:\mathrm{S}_{A^+}\to\mathrm{S}_{B^+}$ is a bijection satisfying \[ \|\Lambda(u)-\Lambda(v)\|=1 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \|u-v\|=1 \qquad (u,v\in\mathrm{S}_{A^+}). \] If $A$ has no two-dimensional irreducible $^*$-representation, then $A$ and $B$ are Jordan $^*$-isomorphic. Moreover, the Jordan $^*$-isomorphism can be chosen to be compatible with $\Lambda$ on the peak and zero projections of positive norm-one elements. The proof is based on recovering the order and orthogonality structure of Akemann closed projections in the bidual. As a main application, we give an affirmative answer to the positive-sphere extension problem for unital $C^*$-algebras of real rank zero. Namely, if $A$ has real rank zero (but could has two-dimensional irreducible $^*$-representations) and $\Lambda:\mathrm{S}_{A^+}\to\mathrm{S}_{B^+}$ is a surjective isometry, then $\Lambda$ extends to a Jordan $^*$-isomorphism from $A$ onto $B$.
item.dc:creator: Chi-Wai Leung, Chi-Keung Ng, Ngai-Ching Wong

item.title: A New Characterisation of Selflessness
item.description: arXiv:2610.32395v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We characterise the existence of expectation-preserving embeddings of reduced amalgamated free product $\mathrm{C}^\ast$-algebras into norm ultrapowers of the first factor, fixing its diagonal copy pointwise, in terms of complementary compression relations on Hilbert space ultrapowers. This yields new characterisations of Robert's notion of selflessness, selfless inclusions, and relative selflessness with respect to conditional expectations. We also characterise Ozawa's notion of complete selflessness, including its extension to inclusions. We then illustrate the usefulness of these characterisations by establishing complete selflessness for suitable reduced (amalgamated) free products, free Araki--Woods $\mathrm{C}^\ast$-algebras, certain Hecke $\mathrm{C}^\ast$-algebras, and $q$-Gaussian $\mathrm{C}^\ast$-algebras. Finally, we obtain dynamical characterisations of (complete) $\mathrm{C}^\ast$-selflessness of discrete groups and establish relative selflessness for suitable reduced crossed products.
item.dc:creator: Mario Klisse, Matteo Pagliero

item.title: Positive Planar Measures for Spectral Pinching and the Corrected BMV Conjecture
item.description: arXiv:2610.31851v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We prove the corrected Bessis--Moussa--Villani pinching conjecture for all symmetrized word averages. For Hermitian matrices $A,B$ and $D=E_A(B)$, we construct a positive compactly supported measure $\zeta_{A,B}$ on $\mathbb R^2$ such that \[ \Tr f(xA+yB)-\Tr f(xA+yD) =y^2\int_{\mathbb R^2}f''(xa+yb)\,d\zeta_{A,B}(a,b). \] Its total mass is $\frac12\|B-D\|_2^2$. This representation proves the corrected conjecture, including its equality cases, and gives a positive bivariate moment representation for the coefficient differences. We also derive complete monotonicity of normalized exponential pinching defects and a comparison with Lie--Trotter approximations. A one-dimensional second-order loss measure is obtained for trace-preserving conditional expectations on finite tracial von Neumann algebras. Finally, we relate $\zeta_{A,B}$ to Hein\"avaara's tracial joint spectral measure by an explicit positive radial transform.
item.dc:creator: Trung Hoa Dinh, Cong Trinh Le, Trung Dung Vuong

item.title: Additive uncertainty relations via pseudospectral methods
item.description: arXiv:2610.32014v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Given Hermitian observable $A$, the variance of $A$ is given by the difference of expectations $\langle A^2\rangle - \langle A\rangle^2$, where the expectation of an observable implicitly assumes a choice of state for the underlying system. As a sub-case of a general lower bound for the sum of variances for finitely many arbitrary elements in a $C^*$-algebra, we prove that the sum of the variances for $d$ observables $A_1, \dots , A_d$ is greater than some expression in the expectations $\langle i[A_j,A_k]\rangle$ for $j\neq k$ plus the square of the smallest singular value of the associated localizer. In special cases, this expression is just a root mean square average. Our technique also derives a general containment between the Clifford pseudospectra and quadratic pseudospectra for $d$ observables.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Cerjan, Lara Ismert, Terry A. Loring

item.title: Block Toeplitz Operators, Matrix Valued Truncated Toeplitz operators, and Conjugations
item.description: arXiv:2610.32170v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we characterize the complex symmetry of block Toeplitz operators on the Hardy-Hilbert space H2(E) with conjugation C_{u,\lambda}, where E is a finite dimensional Hilbert space. We also extend the application of this conjugation to matrix valued truncated Toeplitz operators.
item.dc:creator: Rewayat Khan

item.title: Joint q-Numerical Ranges of Continuous Operator-Valued Functions
item.description: arXiv:2610.32504v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper develops a unified theory of joint $q$-numerical ranges $\Fq(F)$ for continuous functions $F:\Om \to \B(\cH)$, where $\Om$ is a compact Hausdorff space and $\B(\cH)$ denotes the $C^*$-algebra of bounded linear operators on a complex Hilbert space $\cH$. We prove that $\Fq(F)$ is totally bounded in $\cC(\Om)$, the space of continuous complex-valued functions on $\Om$, and establish the upper semicontinuity of the set-valued map $F\mapsto \Fq(F)$, and show that $\Fq(F)$ is compact when $\cH$ is finite-dimensional. The main result of the paper is a realization theorem. We prove that, for every totally bounded subset $K$ of $\cC(\Om)$ and every $q\in \C$ with $|q|=1$, there exist a Hilbert space $\cH$ and a continuous function $F:\Om\to\B(\cH)$ such that $qK\subset \Fq(F)\subset q\cok$. Consequently, if $K$ is closed and convex, then $\Fq(F)=qK$. As applications, we derive analogous realization results for bounded subsets in $\C^n$ and for totally bounded subsets in arbitrary Banach spaces.
item.dc:creator: Amin Azadi

item.title: A $\mathrm{C}^*$-algebraic Hoffman-Wielandt theorem
item.description: arXiv:2605.22585v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We observe that the $2$-norm distance $d_{U,2}$ between the unitary orbits of normal elements in a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $\mathcal{M}$ is equal to the $2$-Wasserstein distance between the spectral measures induced by the trace $\tau_\mathcal{M}$. Using classification and optimal transport theory, we deduce an analogous $2$-norm equation for normal operators $x$ and $y$ in simple, separable, unital, nuclear, $\mathcal{Z}$-stable $\mathrm{C}^*$-algebras that are either monotracial, or real rank zero with finitely many extremal traces, provided that $\sigma(x)=\sigma(y)$ is convex. Consequently, $d_{U,2}$ equips the set of approximate unitary equivalence classes of contractive normal elements of $\mathcal{M}$ with the structure of a compact length space. The same is true of the set of equivalence classes of embeddings into the Jiang-Su algebra $\mathcal{Z}$ of classifiable tracial $2$-Wasserstein spaces over compact, convex planar domains.
item.dc:creator: Bhishan Jacelon

item.title: Hilbert transforms on graph products of finite von Neumann algebras
item.description: arXiv:2607.00194v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study Hilbert transforms on graph products of finite von Neumann algebras, with particular interest in their boundedness on the associated noncommutative $L_p$-spaces for $1<p<\infty$. We establish a generalized Cotlar identity for Hilbert transforms, valid on operators whose lengths exceed a constant depending only on the underlying graph. We further prove that graph products of finite von Neumann algebras satisfying a Haagerup-type inequality admit $L_p$-bounded Hilbert transforms, therefore extending the corresponding result of Mei and Ricard for free products of finite von Neumann algebras. In addition, we obtain several equivalent characterizations of this Haagerup-type inequality. Our results apply, in particular, to graph products of finite groups, right-angled Hecke von Neumann algebras, and graph products of finite quantum groups. As an application, we provide a complete characterization of a compactness problem posed by Ozawa for graph products of finite groups and right-angled Hecke von Neumann algebras.
item.dc:creator: Xiao-Qi Lu, Runlian Xia

item.title: The Cuntz semigroup of the graph C*-algebra of a finite graph
item.description: arXiv:2610.01915v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We compute the Cuntz semigroup of a graph C*-algebra associated to a finite graph by combining Hong and Szyma\'nski's realisation of the entire ideal lattice of a graph C*-algebra, Ara, Moreno and Pardo's computation of the Murray-von Neumann semigroup of a unital graph C*-algebra and various Cuntz semigroup techniques. We also investigate certain properties of such Cuntz semigroups, and demonstrate that at the level of the Cuntz semigroup, there is no obstruction to the conjecture that the nuclear dimension of any graph C*-algebra is at most one.
item.dc:creator: Yao Ming Chan

item.title: Quantum real projective spaces as quantum CW-complexes via topological graphs
item.description: arXiv:2610.02017v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We use the notion and properties of topological graphs to construct a quantum CW complex for quantum real projective spaces. This construction mirrors the CW complex construction in the classical case. Moreover, we introduce multipullback even-spheres as boundaries of noncommutative "cylinders" and show that they admit a gluing akin to the gluing of balls to the ends of a hollow closed cylinder.
item.dc:creator: Atul Gothe

item.title: On the generators of separable unital C*-algebras
item.description: arXiv:2610.17411v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Let $A$ be a separable unital $\mathrm C^*$-algebra with nonempty tracial state space and strict comparison by ordinary tracial states. If $\mathcal Z$ embeds unitally into $A$, then $A$ is singly generated. In particular, every simple separable unital $\mathrm C^*$-algebra $A$ with $\mathrm T(A)\ne\varnothing$ and strict comparison is singly generated.
item.dc:creator: George A. Elliott, Chun Guang Li, Zhuang Niu

item.title: The computable functional calculus
item.description: arXiv:2606.05456v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We show that the continuous functional calculus is computable. As consequences we obtain the computable compactness of the spectrum of any computable normal element of a computably presented $\mathrm{C}^*$-algebra, the existence of effective approximate units for computably presented $\mathrm{C}^*$-algebras, and an effective version of the Spectral Theorem for compact operators on separable Hilbert spaces.
item.dc:creator: Christopher J. Eagle, Timothy H. McNicholl
